company.introduction: BT Group provides fixed and mobile communications through businesses serving consumers, companies and wholesale customers. Its activities include broadband, mobile connectivity under EE, enterprise networking and Openreach infrastructure used by multiple service providers. Revenue comes from subscriptions, access charges and communications services, with customer relationships often extending over recurring contracts. Building and maintaining fibre and mobile networks requires substantial capital investment and technical operations. Its economics depend on network utilisation, customer retention and the cost of delivering reliable service. Competition affects retail pricing, while regulation is particularly important to wholesale infrastructure, where network availability and access terms influence the wider UK communications market.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
